headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential vulnerabilities and security risks early in the development process, ensuring a safer local-first environment. Leverage machine learning models for predictive analytics to offer proactive advice on package selection and updates.
actions: Implement a real-time vulnerability scanner that checks dependencies against known threat databases before installation.
Develop an AI-driven risk assessment tool that predicts potential issues based on historical data of similar projects.
Create a feature that suggests safer alternatives for potentially risky packages, enhancing overall security.
